gloss: nama-fu; fresh wheat gluten (soft and chewy)

definitions.gloss: nama-fu; fresh wheat gluten (soft and chewy)
definitions.explanation: A traditional Japanese food made from wheat gluten mixed with glutinous rice flour, steamed to produce a soft, chewy texture. Eaten as a refined ingredient in Kyoto-style cuisine, Buddhist vegetarian cooking, and high-end Japanese restaurants.

examples.japanese: {生麩|なまふ}の{田楽|でんがく}。
{京都|きょうと}の{料亭|りょうてい}で{生麩|なまふ}を{味|あじ}わった。
examples.english: I enjoyed nama-fu at a high-end restaurant in Kyoto.

examples.japanese: {生麩|なまふ}はもちもちとした{食感|しょっかん}が{特徴|とくちょう}だ。
examples.english: Nama-fu is characterized by its soft, chewy texture.

examples.japanese: {精進料理|しょうじんりょうり}では、{生麩|なまふ}が{肉|にく}の{代|か}わりに{使|つか}われることが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: In Buddhist vegetarian cuisine, nama-fu is often used in place of meat.

notes:
Composed of {生|なま} (fresh; uncooked; raw) and {麩|ふ} (wheat gluten). The {生|なま} here signals that the product has not been dried or toasted, unlike {焼|や}き{麩|ふ} (baked, dry yaki-fu).

USAGE:
A specialty food associated particularly with Kyoto cuisine and {精進料理|しょうじんりょうり} (Buddhist vegetarian cooking). Typically sold refrigerated in blocks and has a shelf life of only a few days. Popular varieties include {粟麩|あわふ} (with millet), {草麩|くさふ} (with mugwort, green-colored), and {紅葉麩|もみじふ} (autumn-leaf shape). Often grilled with miso glaze ({田楽|でんがく}) or served in clear soup as a refined garnish.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {生麩|なまふ}の{田楽|でんがく}: grilled nama-fu with miso glaze
- {生麩|なまふ}{田楽|でんがく}{味噌|みそ}: miso used to top grilled nama-fu
- {京|きょう}{生麩|なまふ}: Kyoto-style nama-fu (a branded regional specialty)
- {生麩|なまふ}を{揚|あ}げる: to deep-fry nama-fu

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {焼|や}き{麩|ふ}: toasted, dried wheat gluten — the dry, light counterpart, used in everyday cooking rather than refined cuisine
- {揚|あ}げ{麩|ふ}: fried wheat gluten — deep-fried for a crisper texture
- {麩|ふ}: wheat gluten — the general category term
- {湯葉|ゆば}: tofu skin — another Kyoto specialty made from soy milk; often served alongside {生麩|なまふ} in refined cuisine
